headline: Global Market & Macro Context
flowing_prose: Global market risk sentiment was driven by concrete overseas geopolitical developments, notably maritime transit restrictions across the Strait of Hormuz, renewed Houthi-Saudi border friction, and the clearance of the $24.3B F-35 defense package to Saudi Arabia, which elevated supply risk premiums across key trade routes. In global energy supply developments, updates on Saudi Aramco's pipeline repair timeline guided near-term export restoration expectations, helping anchor physical crude delivery schedules. Benchmark sovereign bond yields stabilized as institutional participants assessed upcoming central bank policy deliberations. Asian equities opened predominantly in the green following supportive overnight cues from Wall Street, while GIFT Nifty pointed toward a steady to positive opening for domestic bourses. Three Things to Watch: 1) Strait of Hormuz shipping transit alerts and crude tanker freight rates; 2) Domestic fuel marketing margins and upstream realizations as crude benchmarks digest Middle East headlines; 3) Institutional FPI liquidity flows and GIFT Nifty opening trajectory.

headline: IndiGo 2% after India’s largest airline hikes excess baggage and priority service prices
what_happened: InterGlobe Aviation Ltd has announced: InterGlobe Aviation, IndiGo’s operator, raised charges for domestic ancillary services, including infant travel, excess baggage and priority check-in and boarding. The revisions increase passenger costs beyond base fares. IndiGo had reported a Rs 238 crore Q1 FY27 loss amid higher fuel expenses, despite strong revenue growth and expanding domestic and international operations.
